class.name: ModifierData
class.brief_description: A data resource that defines a specific mathematical operation to an attribute.
class.description: [ModifierData] configurations specify how a target attribute should be modified when a gameplay effect is applied. It defines which attribute is targeted [target_id], how much it changes by [value], and the specific mathematical operation used to perform the change [operation_type].

members.member: The mathematical operation used to apply [member value] to the target attribute (ex. adding flat amounts, scaling, or overriding).
The identifier of the source attribute or tag backing this modifier calculation, if applicable.
The unique [StringName] of the attribute that this modifier will alter (ex. [code]&"Health"[/code] or [code]&"Speed"[/code]).
The numerical value used in the calculation. Depending on [operation_type], this can represent a flat value, multiplier, or percentage.

constants.constant: Adds a flat numerical value directly to the attribute's current value. [i]Formula: CurrentValue += ModifierValue[/i]
Multiplies the attribute's current value by a raw scaling factor. [i]Formula: CurrentValue *= ModifierValue[/i]
Calculates a percentage based strictly on the attribute's base value, then adds that calculated amount to the current value. [i]Formula: CurrentValue += (BaseValue * (ModifierValue / 100))[/i]
Multiplies the attribute's current value directly by a percentage factor. [i]Formula: CurrentValue *= (ModifierValue / 100)[/i]
Ignores all other active modifiers and forces the attribute's current value to match this exact value.
